dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: One prominent, high-contrast white band across the greater coverts, sharply defined against the dark wing coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High boundary sharpness with distinct pale edges along the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, irregular white patch on the posterior neck, contrasting highly with the surrounding black and yellow-green areas.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct transition boundary from black crown to a yellow-green mantle, separated by the nape patch.
